products.name: Bardeen
products.note: Browser automation AI; web scraping; personal productivity; data exposure risk

profile_text.body:
Bardeen is an automation and workflow platform aimed at go-to-market teams. The company describes itself as helping those teams eliminate manual tasks by connecting and integrating with third-party tools, automating repetitive workflows, managing data across systems, and enhancing collaboration.

Its primary product, also called Bardeen, centers on an agentic web scraper that sources and qualifies leads using AI and web search providers, combined with contact enrichment to help users reach those leads. The platform also supports broader browser automation and personal productivity use cases, including the ability to find answers on websites at scale.

The site's held facts list no litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patents associated with Bardeen at this time.
